column5: a UserPromptSubmit whose prompt head carries a making verb in an imperative clause and names a proper noun, a quoted term, or a digit-letter token outside code spans; appends to the session ledger and states the gate shape once per prompt that added entries; silent on questions, slash commands, and under CC_ASK_LEDGER=off

a Stop whose session ledger has entries and whose final assistant message lacks a line per entry carrying as named, substituted, or omitted; exit 2 with the missing names, at most twice per session; silent with no ledger and under CC_ASK_LEDGER=off
